title: Appeal of waiver of jurisdiction.
bodyText: An order waiving jurisdiction shall not be appealable as a final order, but may only be appealable in conjunction with an appeal of all other issues after a trial on the charge against such minor or adult.
caseNotes: Does not permit appellate review of order denying waiver of jurisdiction. 66 H. 516, 668 P.2d 25 (1983).

bodyHtml:
[§571-22.5]  Appeal of waiver of jurisdiction.  An order waiving jurisdiction shall not be appealable as a final order, but may only be appealable in conjunction with an appeal of all other issues after a trial on the charge against such minor or adult. [L 1980, c 207, §1]

 

Case Notes

 

  Does not permit appellate review of order denying waiver of jurisdiction.  66 H. 516, 668 P.2d 25 (1983).
